source_en: Papers. Temur Gelashvili. Timber, northern forest. Twice a season in the city.
The birds left the valley this morning. Something's coming from the north.
The kind that changes the air first. You can't smell it yet.
Why come into the city now?
To sell the last timber before the road closes. Then I go back.
The trees past the north gate are [[infected:turning gray]]. Not from cold.
Cut one. The sap came out black. I burned my gloves.
Something leaves marks in the soil no animal makes. I've tracked it a week.
I watch. You should too. Stamp it.
